claims: Assess and manage arterial hypotension (MAP ~60 mmHg) with ongoing phenylephrine infusion; evaluate volume status and titrate vasopressor support.
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status; patient is on 2-4 L/min O2 with SpO2 91-95% and tachypnea (RR 23-28/min); assess need for increased respiratory support.
Continue epidural infusion (hydromorphone/bupivacaine) and monitor for adequate analgesia and hemodynamic effects.
Monitor blood glucose (finger sticks 115-156 mg/dL) and continue dextrose-containing fluids; adjust as needed.
Monitor electrolytes and renal function (creatinine 0.9, potassium 4.4, sodium 137, chloride 106, bicarbonate 27); repeat labs as clinically indicated.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (12.1/33.3-34.6) and assess for bleeding or anemia; repeat CBC if indicated.
Perform fall risk and mobility assessment (Braden activity chairfast/bedfast, bed rest); implement fall precautions and encourage mobility as tolerated.
Continue incentive spirometry and cough/deep breathing exercises to prevent pulmonary complications.
Monitor pain level and response to analgesia; current pain reported as none to mild.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis as ordered (e.g., sequential compression devices or pharmacologic) and monitor.
